description: This Java source file defines the CreateGestureActivity class, an Android activity for creating and saving user gestures within a gesture builder application. It manages gesture input, state preservation, and interaction with gesture storage.

classes.name: CreateGestureActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for creating, displaying, and saving gestures, handling user interactions and gesture lifecycle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up gesture overlay listener.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current gesture state for activity recreation.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the gesture state after activity recreation.

methods.name: addGesture
methods.description: Handles saving the created gesture with a user-provided name.

methods.name: cancelGesture
methods.description: Cancels gesture creation and finishes the activity.
